**Build passes now, exit 0.** Two real bugs, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | accept both |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | unset flag is now `undefined`, threw | treat as `false` |

The 8 remaining lines are deprecation warnings. Real ones, but not errors. Worth clearing next: `Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, and `crypto.createCipher` in `src/legacy/`.
